correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the current tree gives exact updates D'=D+X and L'=L+1-Y with E[X|T]=D/(2(n-1)), E[Y|T]=L/(2(n-1)), and E[XY|T]=1{D=1}/(2(n-1)). These identities reconstruct the mixed-moment recurrence. The marginal recurrences solve to the displayed q_n, E D_n, and E L_n, and substitution yields the covariance increment. Every claimed sign follows from that exact increment, and the square-root constant follows from q_n~(pi n)^(-1/2). Exact rational state enumeration through n=9 reproduces all finite identities.

value.rationale: The distinguished oldest vertex and the total leaf population are canonical nonexchangeable local/global observables in preferential attachment. Their one-step competition does not make the sign obvious. The exact positive increment law exposes the mechanism and the asymptotic 2 sqrt(n)/(3 sqrt(pi)) quantifies a persistent hub-boundary coupling not captured by aggregate degree-count covariances.
